crossRefs.note: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God…
But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.
Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from Yahweh.
I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t…

translations.web: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
translations.bsb: Do not both adversity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
translations.kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
translations.asv: Out of the mouth of the Most High cometh there not evil and good?
